Number(v) : v` narrow, `n` is already `number`, so the `as number` cast is redundant (same in `formatServedSqft` and `formatSqm`) and hides nothing — fix: drop the cast.

DEFER severity=NIT — mobile/__tests__/leadDetailFormat.test.ts:77 "expect(formatCostTier('giga' as never))" — `formatCostTier` accepts `string | null`, so `'giga' as never` is an unnecessary unsafe cast in the unknown-tier test — fix: pass `'giga'` directly.

DEFER severity=NIT — mobile/__tests__/parcelCostFormat.test.ts:79 "// so its test leaves. Prior text: describe('SponsorSlot renders null while flag-off (Spec 100 §6.8)') asserted SponsorSlot({placement:" — commented-out prior test body is dead text carried in the file — fix: keep only the dated one-line removal note if the record is needed, drop the old assert body.

DEFER severity=MED — src/app/admin/report-preview/page.tsx:41 "const pg = PAGE_GOLDENS[target] as { response_fixture: { synthetic?: boolean }; rendered_tree: object };" — target is validated only against TARGETS (reportCtx.layout) or the hardcoded fallback 'web' at :37, never against the PAGE_GOLDENS keys, so a target with no page golden indexes undefined and :42 throws on pg.rendered_tree; the nav at :48 links every TARGET to that view — Fix: resolve the page target from Object.keys(PAGE_GOLDENS) and notFound() when PAGE_GOLDENS[target] is undefined.

DEFER severity=MED — src/app/admin/report-preview/page.tsx:30 "const syntheticUrls = (tree: Tree): Record<string, string> => Object.fromEntries((tree.nodes.find((n) => n.kind === 'image')?.images ?? []).map((i) => [i.asset_id, PLACEHOLDER]));" — find() takes only the first top-level image node, so every later image node (or nested one) keeps an unmapped asset_id and renders without a URL — Fix: collect across all image nodes (filter or flatMap, recursing into children if nodes nest).

DEFER severity=LOW — src/app/admin/report-preview/page.tsx:57 "const view = viewOf(golden.rendered_tree, { scenario, target, urls: syntheticUrls(golden.rendered_tree as Tree), reportHref }, reportCtx) as View;" — rendered_tree is cast to Tree without any check that nodes exists at :30, so a golden of another shape throws a TypeError instead of a readable preview — Fix: narrow with Array.isArray(tree?.nodes) before use, or let viewOf report the bad tree.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/app/admin/report-preview/page.tsx:42 "const pv = pageViewOf(pg.rendered_tree, { target }, reportCtx) as PageView;" — the cast discards the function's own return type, so a projection change in report/core becomes a silent wrong render rather than a type error (same at :57 "as View") — Fix: drop both casts and let pageViewOf/viewOf types flow.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/app/api/leads/detail/[id]/types.ts:38 "location: LeadDetailLocation | null;" — the published contract also declares lifecycle_phase (:47) and updated_at (:60), but the surface descriptor's whitelist stops at "lifecycle_stalled", "competition_count", "is_saved" (scripts/surfaces/estate_other/F90/surfaces/mobile_lead_detail.descriptor.json), so the declared field set and the contract already disagree — Fix: add location, lifecycle_phase and updated_at to inputs.field_whitelist or drop them from the contract.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/app/api/leads/detail/[id]/types.ts:60 "updated_at: string;" — the docstring pins the source to "permits.updated_at" while the same interface declares "lead_type: 'permit' | 'coa';" (:33), so a CoA lead has no non-null source for a non-nullable field — Fix: type it "string | null" or document the permit-only invariant and narrow lead_type.

DEFER severity=LOW — scripts/surfaces/_schema/report-v2-seed/schema-v2-proposal.json "Same-form comps (per card)" "comp_fsi_p50_same_form · comparable_builds_same_form[]" — both fields are already listed under "Comparables for this build type (per card)" in the same market section with the same status "new", so this row adds no field and only restates the gap-5 note — Fix: delete the duplicate row or keep only the fields it alone introduces.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/app/admin/report-preview/page.tsx:31 "const pick = (v: string | undefined, allowed: string[], fallback: string): string => (v !== undefined && allowed.includes(v) ? v : fallback);" — the fallback is returned unchecked against allowed, so the one function meant to keep query params inside their closed set is the one place that can emit a value outside it (used at :36 and :37) — Fix: return allowed.includes(fallback) ? fallback : allowed[0] and assert allowed is non-empty.

DEFER severity=MED — src/lib/surfaces/maxbld-landing.ts "if (p.role === 'checked') return Object.keys(values).some((k) => k.startsWith(`checked.${p.group}.`));" — the keep-test accepts any one citywide key, while figuresNode in StaticBinding.tsx emits a ref for every CITYWIDE_KEYS entry (`derived(\`checked.${p.group}.${k}\`)`) and valueOf throws on a missing one, so a partial stored row keeps the part and then throws at render instead of degrading — require every citywide key here (or have figuresNode skip keys absent from values) so a partial row falls back to the degraded page.

DEFER severity=MED — src/lib/leads/lead-detail-query.ts "  opportunity_score: number | null;" — opportunity_score is selected raw while every other decimal in the same SELECT is cast (ce.estimated_cost::text, ce.cost_range_low::text, p.latitude::text) and unwrapped by toNumberOrNull, and the file header states pg returns NUMERIC as a string, so if trade_forecasts.opportunity_score is NUMERIC the mapper passes a string through a field typed number — add ::text plus toNumberOrNull like the cost columns, or confirm the column is an int column.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/lib/surfaces/maxbld-landing.ts "String(tpl[l.key]).replace(SLOT, () => l.value)" — a citywide line key with no matching template becomes the literal text "undefined" rendered as a public figure, with no throw and no log — throw a named error when tpl[l.key] is not a string, the way ReportPage.tsx renderFooter does for an unknown text key.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/components/report/ReportPage.tsx "back={one(s, 'size.panel.hide')}" — the how sheet's Back control is fed the size panel's hide part, not a how-panel part, so the dialog can show another panel's wording — pass the hide part that belongs to this dialog, as the size and cost dialogs do.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/components/report/ReportPage.tsx "const vs = all(s, value);" — labels and values are paired by index with no check that the two counts match, so a build defect shows a label with no value (T returns null) and nothing throws or logs — compare ls.length to vs.length and throw on a mismatch, as the neighbouring builders do.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/components/surfaces/web/StaticBinding.tsx "const defined = (o: Json): Record<string, never> => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(o).filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined)) as Record<string, never>;" — the declared return says every prop value is never, so the cast disables prop type checking for every Mantine spread in the file and a wrong-typed value (onClick as a string, tabIndex as a string) would not be caught — declare the real spread type instead of never.

DEFER severity=NIT — src/lib/surfaces/maxbld-landing.ts "return { title: `${c['nav.home']} ${c['hero.tagline']}`, description: String(c['hero.sub']).replace(SLOT, () => scenarioList()) };" — c is cast to Record<string, string>, so a missing content key yields "undefined undefined" as the page title rather than a throw — reuse a validated lookup (pickFooterText style) for these keys.

DEFER severity=MED — src/tests/surfaces/search-parity.golden.test.ts:26 "if (keys.length === 1 && KINDS.includes(keys[0] as string)) return [`${keys[0]}:${String(o[keys[0] as string])}`];" — a node that carries a ref key plus any second key returns no ref at all (the fallback recursion over its string values returns []), so a ref difference inside such a node is invisible to parityProblems, and the helper's own doc says "Every binding ref under `v`" — emit a ref for every KINDS key present (loop KINDS) instead of requiring a single-key object, before this lock is trusted.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/tests/surface-registry.infra.test.ts:368 "const orphans = contracts.filter((c) => Array.isArray(c['x-draft']?.consumers) && c['x-draft']!.consumers!.length === 0);" — the test is titled "every CONTRACT declares consumers" but nothing asserts that; a contract with no x-draft, or with consumers absent/null, is silently skipped rather than reported as an orphan — assert every CONTRACT row has an array at x-draft.consumers first, then filter for the empty ones.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/tests/surface-registry.infra.test.ts:135 "const other = ['QUERY', 'MUTATION', 'WEBHOOK', 'COMMAND', 'EXPORT', 'TRANSLATION', 'SCHEDULED', 'DISPATCH'];" — the SURFACE archetypes are read from the schema while the CONTRACT/JOB ones are a hand-copied list, so a new contract archetype in the schema fails a valid census row and a removed one still passes — read the contract/job archetypes from the schema too, as the file header itself demands no hand-maintained tables.

DEFER severity=MED — src/tests/surfaces/site-footer.ui.test.tsx:53 "expect((container.innerHTML.match(new RegExp((C['search.legal'] as string).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'g')) ?? []).length, name).toBe(1);" — the regex is built from the raw string but tested against serialized HTML, so any character React escapes in a text node (apostrophe becomes ', ampersand becomes &) makes the count 0 and the "once in the whole markup" check fail for a reason that has nothing to do with the component, while test (c) already counts on textContent — run the count on container.textContent (or f.textContent) and escape only the regex metacharacters.

DEFER severity=MED — src/tests/surfaces/site-footer.ui.test.tsx:48 "for (const [name, s] of Object.entries(SITUATIONS).filter(([, v]) => Array.isArray((v as Json).recent))) {" — if the fixture shape drifts (nothing verifies the JSON, line 29 casts it straight to Record<string, WebSituation>) the filter yields an empty list, the body never runs, and this "every state" test passes green with zero assertions — assert Object.keys(SITUATIONS).length is greater than 0 and assert each entry has recent before the loop, reporting the offending name.

DEFER severity=MED — src/tests/surfaces/site-footer.ui.test.tsx:67 "const f = container.querySelector('footer[data-testid="static-footer"]') as HTMLElement;" — the as cast erases the real null that querySelector returns (same at lines 97, 99, 101 with "as Element" and 78 with "as HTMLElement"), so a selector typo surfaces as "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'querySelectorAll')" from linksOf instead of a failing assertion — bind the element, expect it not to be null, then read, so the null check is in the test rather than in the type system's blind spot.

DEFER severity=LOW — src/tests/surfaces/site-footer.ui.test.tsx:79 "const sec = (view('web').sections as Json[]).find((s) => s.kind === 'footer') as Json;" — double unchecked cast, and line 80 "sec.parts.find((p: Json) => p.brief === 'G2').text as string" dereferences find() without a guard, so a golden missing the footer or the G2 part throws a bare TypeError instead of failing the named assertion — assert the found part is defined before reading .text, and drop the as PageView cast on line 31 by letting pageViewOf's return type speak.

[]).length).toBe(1);" — the copyright is checked through a hardcoded fragment instead of C['footer.copyright'], so a copy change makes the test pass or fail for the wrong reason while the "copyright once" claim rests on the literal — build the count from C['footer.copyright'] with the same escape helper used at line 53.
